headline: No shared execution or data path is documented; the main residual risk is low prompt-injection/cascading confusion from file-based audio workflows.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Agent A is game-playing with no documented I/O surfaces or shared channel; Agent B only reads audio files and has no clipboard/MCP/filesystem write path. A direct injection bridge is therefore not documented, but if B is fed attacker-controlled transcripts from A’s outputs, the risk is limited and requires unusual orchestration.
conditions: IF an operator manually copies A’s text into B’s transcription prompt
IF a wrapper converts A’s output into an audio-file transcript for B to consume
mitigations: Keep A and B in separate workspaces
Do not paste A output into B prompts
Require human review before any transcript is reused
Use a provenance tag on any handoff file
requires-engineering: add an explicit trust boundary between agents

B_data_leakage.rationale: A has network egress none and no data classes touched; B has no filesystem read/write, no clipboard, no screen capture, and no API calls. With no shared workspace or outbound channel documented, there is no plausible leakage path from A to B or from B to A in the profiles provided.
conditions: IF either agent is later granted filesystem access
IF either agent is connected to a shared workspace or API sink
mitigations: Keep both agents offline
Avoid mounting a shared directory
Do not grant B filesystem read access
Do not grant A any outbound network path
requires-engineering: add DLP controls if sharing is introduced

C_capability_conflict.rationale: A exposes no write or network capabilities in the profile, while B explicitly cannot write the filesystem, modify git state, or spawn subprocesses. Because neither agent can mutate a shared resource, there is no capability overlap that would create a write conflict.
conditions: IF A is later given filesystem or git write permissions
IF B is later wrapped with write-enabled tooling
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only
Do not enable git automation
Do not mount a shared writable directory
Audit any future tool grants before deployment
requires-engineering: add locking if writes are introduced

D_cascading_error.rationale: B can process audio/speech files, but A is a game-playing agent with no documented output channel into B and no evidence that B treats A as authoritative. Any cascade would require an external orchestrator to convert A’s output into B’s input, so the pathway is not default and the blast radius is small.
conditions: IF an orchestrator feeds A-generated text into B as source material
IF B is configured to transcribe or summarize A outputs without verification
mitigations: Insert a verification step before B consumes A output
Label A output as untrusted in the wrapper
Use separate queues for raw and verified inputs
Review any downstream automation rules
requires-engineering: add provenance checks to the pipeline

E_compliance.rationale: No compliance mismatch is documented: A touches no data classes and B touches audio/speech only, with no residency, certification, retention, or subject-rights differences stated. Because the profiles lack any regulated-data flow or policy divergence, a compliance breach pathway is not established.
conditions: IF regulated data such as PHI or EU PII is introduced into either agent
IF a deployment policy imposes residency or retention rules not shown here
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the pair
Document retention settings before use
Review vendor policy for any future data class expansion
Avoid mixing jurisdictions in one workflow
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement if regulated data is introduced
